image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a large common iguana resting in grassy vegetation. The image focuses on the head, neck, and upper torso. The iguana displays a prominent dorsal crest of spines running down its neck and back. The skin texture is detailed with granular scales and a large subtympanic shield is visible below the ear area. The coloration is a mix of greyish-green and brown, suggesting an adult or specific lighting condition, rather than bright juvenile green. The background consists of blurred green foliage and dry twigs.
